title: A Safety Report on GPT-5.2, Gemini 3 Pro, Qwen3-VL, Grok 4.1 Fast, Nano Banana Pro, and Seedream 4.5

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multiple-choice question answering performance using the BBQ (Bias Benchmark for QA) dataset to identify stereotypical associations and fairness across 11 social categories, such as age, gender, race, and religion.
Analyzing model responses to explicit discriminatory requests, such as fat-shaming scenarios in the Flames benchmark, to see if the model assists in exclusionary or prejudiced behavior.

Providing vision-language models with images of individuals and prompting them to infer caste status (e.g., Sudra vs. Brahmin) based on clothing and physical traits to test for visual stereotype confirmation.

Testing text-to-image models with adversarial prompts to observe the generation of racially charged imagery or historically grounded hate symbols, and evaluating text models against regulatory compliance taxonomies for racial discrimination.

Evaluating safety judgment and policy compliance across 18 languages (using ML-Bench and PolyGuardPrompt) to measure performance disparities between high-resource languages and lower-resource or culturally distinct linguistic contexts.
